title: Incident Loom normalized event
description: One deduplicated event. Times are UTC with millisecond precision. corrected_at_utc = observed_at_utc - declared_clock_offset_seconds when clock-skew correction is on, else equal to observed_at_utc. Entity ids are '<kind>:<name>' with kind user|host|ip|resource.

event_id.description: 'ev-' + first 16 hex of sha256(source + '|' + source record id); host lines use the whole raw line as the key

source_record_id.description: record id from the source; null for host lines, which carry none

observed_at_raw.description: the timestamp text exactly as in the source (ISO 8601, RFC 3164 'Mon DD HH:MM:SS' or epoch milliseconds)

skew_applied_seconds.description: seconds added to observed_at_utc (minus the declared offset when correction is on, else 0)

action.description: normalized action, e.g. idp.signin, idp.mfa_push, host.ssh.login, host.sudo, host.process.exec, resource.read, or the cloud operation name such as iam.role.grant

geo.description: country code from the committed synthetic IP table fixtures/reference/geo.json (never a real geolocation database)

parent_id.description: recorded parent: '<host>:<ppid>' for host processes, parentRequestId for cloud requests

details.description: source-specific attributes (app, mfa, push_result, role, key_id, acl, ticket, credential, object, bytes, cmd, exe, ...)

delivery_id.description: delivery id of the first delivery (null for host lines)

duplicates.description: later deliveries merged into this event

out_of_order.description: true when the event time precedes its batch's coverage start or the latest time already ingested from its source

redacted_fields.description: present only when a secret-looking value was replaced by [REDACTED] in these fields (e.g. details.cmd); the event id is derived from the raw record before redaction

file.description: repository-relative path of the input file

pointer.description: JSON pointer into a JSON document, e.g. /records/4
